notes: James liked the How_Reality_Works reference slides: letterboxed band, mystical/surreal footage, captions on the black bar. That is now the default look.
Voice: Liam (TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ). James sometimes records his own VO in ElevenLabs and uploads the mp3 - drop it in the build dir as vo.mp3.
Format switched to 9:16 (1080x1920) on 2026-07-09. All future videos are phone-ratio.
v5: word-synced captions (whisper), CLIP footage matching (CI), -14 LUFS master, GitHub Actions render farm option.
Mood: LIT-but-moody, not near-black. Prefer window light, god rays, lamplight, golden hour. A few dark slides fine; majority must have visible lighting. Ending scenes must match the words literally.
Music bed at 0.21 (slightly louder). Clips must never visibly restart/loop mid-scene: pipeline stretches or boomerangs short clips and prefers clips >= scene duration.

Approved The Old Version. Still too many dark scenes: keep the lit-but-moody look but lift exposure/brightness across more slides. Prefer visibly illuminated faces, rooms, landscapes, window light, god rays, lamplight, and golden hour; reserve near-dark footage for only a few intentional beats. No rerender needed for this approved version.
Scene 0 is the thumbnail: it must show picture + title from frame one (no fade-in), and its query should be an especially striking LIT visual.
Music bed at 0.26 (raised twice from 0.16; James kept wanting it louder - keep it clearly audible under the VO).

Training v8: open with rapid same-color hook montage (1-3s beats), vary rhythm (short punches vs 8-14s holds), word-literal prop slides, 3-5 human/face beats incl. pointing-at-camera on direct address, closer slide visually reframes premise, final line echoes the title. See style_profile v8 section.

Tricky props (e.g. dominoes): if a query misfires twice, curate manually - search the Pexels API, eyeball thumbnails, then PIN the clip by setting scene pexels_id (re-fetch-by-id makes it deterministic).
Title card: 2x size (190px Baloo ExtraBold), ALL-CAPS, multi-line stack allowed, may extend past the letterbox band but never into captions.

DMT genre exists: set genre:dmt in script.json for trip/visionary scripts (title usually says DMT). Vivid saturated visuals, narrator room anchor, literal metaphor building, long morphing holds. See style_profile DMT section.

Hero shots exist: scene flag hero:true + image_prompt generates free AI imagery (pollinations, keyless) animated with 2.5D depth parallax. Use on 2-4 impossible-metaphor beats, the thumbnail scene, and closers.

v11: generative cinematic score (chord pads, reverb, stereo, genre-aware) + synthesized sound design (title/closer sub-drops, whooshes after long holds, closer riser). All free/synthesized, automatic.

v12: footage from NASA/Prelinger/Wikimedia/Pixabay too (keyless, namespaced ids). Every scene saves top-3 alternates (alts.json + alts_sheet.jpg artifact); use learn.py pin <bd> <i> <id> to swap surgically.
v13: renders auto-publish permanent GitHub Releases (video-<slug>); batch workflow renders multiple slugs in parallel; issue studio works keyless via pollinations text fallback.
v14: taste vector live - record/swap feed a learned aesthetic embedding (pipeline/taste.npz, commit it with memory.json). Ranker blends it automatically once 8+ approved embeddings exist.
Identity-specific footage must visibly match the named identity and action. For entering scenes, show a front-facing subject crossing into the room; avoid back-of-head shots that read as leaving.

June Oxley videos are explicit opt-in only: use candid Southern rural/front-porch scenes, ordinary literal props and warm visible light, with occasional deadpan cosmic interruptions; use the dedicated twangy porch music profile. Never apply this style to other videos.
June Oxley is an old white man. Keep this identity consistent in every June Oxley script, character description, human footage query, and generated hero image; do not portray him as Black.

Default still and hero slides must look like natural photographic frames that match the surrounding stock footage. Avoid gold fog, heavy volumetric haze, silhouetted figures, theatrical fantasy lighting, and visibly synthetic staging unless explicitly requested.
All new videos must default to 1080x1920 9:16 portrait. Scene-0 titles must automatically wrap and shrink as needed to remain fully inside the portrait safe area without entering the caption zone.

No more than 35% of finished runtime may be static-image slides. Pan/zoom/Ken Burns alone still counts as static. Prefer true footage or generated motion for ordinary actions; animate supplied stills with depth-separated/internal motion or controlled keyframe evolution, and measure the cap by seconds rather than scene count.

Correction: no more than 35% of finished runtime may come from still images in any form. Static slides, Ken Burns, depth animation, cinemagraph treatment, and staged keyframe animation all count toward the same still-derived 35%. At least 65% must be genuine recorded or generated temporal footage with people, objects, or environments actually moving; the permitted stills should still receive the motion treatment.

Visual-symbol training from the 2026-07-14 reference: match the mechanism of each spoken line, not merely its mood. People are valid symbols only when they have a clear role; do not default to generic thoughtful-person footage. Deliberately alternate human, collective, perception, language, architecture, pathway, identity, time/memory, tool, nature, world-scale, geometry, transformation, and light/atmosphere symbols. Prefer one precise physical metaphor, limit repeated families and props, and ask whether the idea would remain legible with captions hidden.

Still-image training from 2026-07-14: acquire genuine stock slides first, then choose the closest related selected stock-video frame and use that exact frame as the generated still's visual reference. Every still receives the full natural-photo, exposure/detail, depth/background, internal-motion, practical-light, grade, and grain treatment; preserve supplied originals, reject pan/zoom-only slides, keep all still-derived time inside the 35% cap, and fall back to genuine footage rather than emit an unreferenced generated still.

Rejected The Belief Filter and renamed it Can You Fly?. Preserve approved scenes 1, 7, 23-27, 29-33, and 35. Revision grammar: 2 moving exclamation mark; 3 rooftop person with arms out; 4 moving question mark; 5 directional street sign and never guns; 6 two people staring; 8 one of those belief-scene people alone in an empty room; 9 choose a different person; 10 person shaking head no; 11 and 19 brain schematics; 12 hang glider; 15 protected-house security sign; 16 police officer badge; 17 matching puzzle with a door; 18 flashing red emergency beacon; 20 glasses or magnifier; 21 access denied; 28 crossed or circled question mark; 34 actual living-room furniture; 36 courtroom witness testifying; 37 person putting on glasses. Match literal mechanism first, then metaphor. Use enhanced stock-frame-conditioned stills when exact footage is unavailable.

Approved Can You Fly?. Keep question marks, exclamation points, and ACCESS DENIED graphics in a cohesive shared color and template, but avoid flat or cartoonish treatment. Future punctuation and warning beats should use slick high-resolution 3D dimensional materials, realistic cinematic light, depth, and motion, or literal human interaction such as a person holding a question mark. Preserve visual-system cohesion while making the result tactile, premium, and photographic.

Every render must generate and archive at least three genuinely distinct full-length background-music choices with identical narration and visuals. Default delivery shows only Deep Current's portrait and 1920x1080 YouTube download links; surface the other two choices only when James specifically asks for them. Keep final.mp4 as the choice-1 compatibility copy and name the default delivery files in music_variants.json.

motifs.name: the dimmer switch
motifs.line: You were never broken. The dimmer was just moving slower than you were watching.

motifs.name: the hidden question
motifs.line: Are you brave enough to change what you keep asking?

motifs.name: the wall of doors
motifs.line: Stop entering the same door and calling the hallway destiny.

motifs.name: the future's fingerprints
motifs.line: Every version of tomorrow leaves fingerprints on the choices you make now.

motifs.name: the deepest sleep
motifs.line: The deepest sleep isn't believing the illusion. It's believing you're the only one who escaped it.

motifs.name: the inner search
motifs.line: Sometimes your inner search has simply never asked to see it.

motifs.name: the loading screen
motifs.line: You were never standing in the world... you were standing in the loading screen.
